notes: "A document model still needs an editor people want to use. The canvas remains available for direct manipulation, with Project, Pages, Assets and Files on the left and object properties, layers and Story on the right. An agent’s changes appear in that same work. I wanted AI collaboration to coexist with selecting objects, arranging layers and refining the composition by hand."
